principal.subtitulo: Create, manage and follow your favourite wargame tournaments easily and efficiently.

novedades.escenarios_texto: You'll soon be able to upload them so organisers can pick them when setting up tournaments. Coming soon!
novedades.escenarios_texto2: Enjoy your favourite app in both English and Spanish. Let's grow the Hobby together — currently available for SAGA, with more game systems coming soon!
novedades.gakis_intro: A new game mode with special rules for Gakis models. Enable it when creating your tournament in the advanced settings. With it you can add extra options to your SAGA tournaments, such as:
novedades.gakis_f1_texto: Use your legendary heroes in SAGA battles.
novedades.gakis_f2_texto: The standard SAGA tournament format uses normal game points and winning by 3 or more makes you the winner. Selecting Tournament Points will use the scoring system from the Tournament book.
novedades.gakis_f3_texto: Want Warlord kills to actually matter? Enable this and every warlord kill adds 1 VP to the final standings.
novedades.gakis_f4_texto: Secondary missions can now be added to your tournaments. Completing them could earn you up to 1 VP towards the final standings.
novedades.dracula_texto: You can now create tournaments for the DRACULA'S AMERICA wargame.

ranking.subtitulo: See where you rank globally and fight your way to the top!
ranking.info_titulo: How does the ELO Ranking System work?
ranking.elo_texto: We use the standard ELO system to calculate your score based on wins, losses, and opponent strength.
ranking.cat_info_texto: Work your way up from Novice to Grand Master based on your ELO.
ranking.temp_texto: A new season starts every year. Battle your way to the top!
ranking.multi_texto: Independent rankings for SAGA, Warmaster and Flames of War.
